_notes_parts: Parts economy (docs/parts-contract.md; design doc 'Early Era, Parts & Maintenance'). Made at a Machine Shop (data/surfaces/fabrication.json recipes) from refined metals: parts (tier part) go into spare kits (tier spare: what repairs use) and construction parts (tier construction: building costs, later). They are ordinary resources: they sit in the player's stock and take storage space, volume per unit (1 for a part, 2 for a kit or construction part; every other resource counts 1). The design doc's recipes use plasma conduits, isolinear chips and transparent aluminum; nothing makes those on the surface yet, so the recipes use duranium, tritanium and parasteel only (control modules stand for circuit boards; isolinear later). Stored kits never decay. Tier drone: a packed scout drone (volume 3), made at a Machine Shop like the parts; a finished Drone Pad takes one from stock into each empty bay. description: what the item is and what it goes into, shown on the Machine Shop's item card in the game (every part item needs one; GameData.Validate checks it).

resources.name: Structural Frame
resources.description: A welded duranium truss with tritanium joints. The skeleton of mechanical spare kits and prefab modules.

resources.name: Hull Plating
resources.description: Pressed parasteel plates, riveted and ready to fit. Armour for rover spares and the walls of prefab modules.

resources.name: Mechanism
resources.description: A geared drive train with its housing. Goes into mechanical and rover spares, and into machinery sets.

resources.name: Power Coupling
resources.description: A sealed connector that joins high-power lines. Goes into electrical spares, machinery sets and scout drones.

resources.name: Control Module
resources.description: A ruggedised circuit board in a sealed case: the brain of a machine. Goes into electrical and environmental spares, machinery sets and scout drones.
resources.lore: Circuit boards for now; isolinear modules later.

resources.name: Seal Kit
resources.description: Gaskets, O-rings and sealant. Goes into environmental spares.

resources.name: Mechanical Spares
resources.description: A crate of bearings, seals, belts and fasteners. The crew use it to repair mining crawlers and most buildings (mine, refinery, storage, Machine Shop). One kit restores a set amount of condition.

resources.name: Electrical Spares
resources.description: Breakers, cabling and power cells for the high-voltage kit. Repairs the Fusion Reactor and the Research Lab.

resources.name: Rover Spares
resources.description: Suspension parts, armour patches and a spare tyre. Repairs survey rovers and the construction rover, and fits new tyres on the repair pad.

resources.name: Environmental Spares
resources.description: Filters, membranes and pressure seals. Keeps Pressure Domes and Life Support Plants airtight.

resources.name: Prefab Module
resources.description: A ready-made wall and floor section. A construction part for bigger buildings (with later missions).

resources.name: Machinery Set
resources.description: A motor, a pump and their controls, boxed. A construction part for industry upgrades (with later missions).

resources.name: Scout Drone
resources.description: A packed, folded scout drone. A Drone Pad takes one from stock into each empty bay.
resources.lore: A packed quad tilt-rotor scout, made at a Machine Shop; a Drone Pad unpacks it into a free bay.
